about: A Rust library that reads RSS, Atom and JSON Feed news feeds.

prs.title: JSON feeds with a number as an item id are read
prs.broken: A JSON feed where one item's id was a number failed to load at all, though the JSON Feed rules say readers should accept it.
prs.changed: An item id can now be a number or text.
prs.matters: Feed readers built on it no longer drop whole feeds over one item.
